title: Protect Yourself
Report the Fire to the Crew
Isolate Ignition Sources
Suppress the Fire
Check the Atmosphere
Restore Safe Conditions
body: Protect yourself from smoke and hazardous combustion products using approved protective equipment and following emergency procedures.
Immediately alert the crew and follow the spacecraft fire-reporting and warning procedures.
Isolate affected equipment from its power source only when directed by the spacecraft approved emergency procedures.
Use approved fire-suppression equipment according to crew training and spacecraft-specific procedures.
Check for smoke and harmful combustion products before considering the surrounding atmosphere safe.
Resume normal operations only after the atmosphere and affected equipment have been assessed and declared safe under approved procedures.
